verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase automatically runs backend code in response to background events, HTTPS requests, Admin SDK calls, or Cloud Scheduler jobs. It can react to Firebase Authentication and Cloud Storage triggers, among other Firebase and Google Cloud events, which covers the core of event-triggered automation. Missing for 10: a declarative or no-code rule definition layer (triggers must be written as deployed code), detailed documentation of the trigger catalog, and independent hands-on corroboration of trigger reliability.
